tagline: Proprietary Minecraft launcher (formerly TL Legacy, Russia) — marked UNSAFE
description: Legacy Launcher (formerly known as TL Legacy) is a closed-source proprietary Minecraft launcher of Russian origin. While it supports vanilla and modded versions (Forge, Fabric, NeoForge, OptiFine) and account management, it is NOT free/open-source software and is marked as UNSAFE due to documented security risks.
features: Supports vanilla Minecraft, Forge, Fabric, NeoForge, and OptiFine
Account management for Microsoft, Ely.by, and offline profiles
Marked as UNSAFE — see video evidence in the project card
